pose.alphaDefinition: fixture_phi_theta_alpha_v1: theta is elevation at alpha=0; alpha rotates the initial vertical pencil plane about its desk-projection hinge. Positive tips toward fixture-local right, which rotates with phi. Range [-90,90]. At theta=90 use the fixture reference line, never derive it from the zero-length projection. Phi remains whole-holder desk-vertical yaw, not Pencil axial roll.
pose.phiDefinition: Whole holder yaw about desk vertical; positive clockwise viewed from above; demo fixture orientation=0; 360 equivalent to 0. Not Pencil axial roll.
pose.referenceNote: φ=0: 기존 데모의 홀더 방향. θ=90°에서 로고 왼쪽. 펜의 독립적인 축 회전은 고정.
pose.thetaDefinition: Pencil axis elevation above desk plane: horizontal=0, vertical=90.

scope: Fixed-pose provisional multiprototype local k-NN. Four correlated representatives per placement; not independent examples. No pose/guide/tip coordinates are inference inputs. No independent evaluation of the combined model yet.
